review_rule: Record only concrete case-specific official task, user-intent, or policy obligations not fully operationalized by the released evaluator/oracle. Exclude reviewer preferences and all agent outcomes or released results.

condition.S: All conjuncts in condition.text are established by the condition's scorer-visible retained evidence.
condition.F: At least one conjunct is established false by retained evidence.
condition.U: No conjunct is established false, but at least one necessary conjunct is unresolved because evidence is missing, incomplete, or non-decisive.

aggregate.F: At least one stronger condition is F.
aggregate.U: No stronger condition is F and at least one is U.

condition_verdict_rule.action_absence_boundary: For a condition about whether an action occurred, absence is F only when the retained action/API trace is established complete; otherwise it is U.
condition_verdict_rule.separation: Stronger results are scored and reported independently. Stronger F does not change native S/F/U. Neither stronger F alone nor native S together with stronger F is sufficient to establish benchmark conflict; only the independent benchmark-conflict audit gate may do so.
